cr177436_hover_ct_source: NASA CR-177436 List of Symbols pp. xiv–xvi and §7.1, Figs. 7.1–7.3, pp. 50–54
cr177436_hover_ct_data_kind: PUBLISHED PLOTS; no graph-digitized values used
cr177436_hover_ct_coverage: Isolated full-scale baseline metal rotor hover tests. Figure 7.3 uses measured blade pitch at 0.75R. Ames run averages 582.8–586.2 rpm and tip Mach 0.688–0.691. The separate WPAFB whirl-tower comparison includes a 740 ft/s tip-speed series.
cr177436_hover_ct_limitation: Ames recorded collective is suitable for curve shape only, per p. 53. The WPAFB pitch comparison is uncorrected for tower blockage and differs by about 4°. TMPE lacks a verified pilot-command-to-0.75R pitch mapping and matched test setup, so has no supported pitch interval. Installed climb and transition are outside the isolated hover coverage.
